findings.title: Container runs as root
findings.description: Illustrative example. No USER instruction, so the container runs as root.
findings.recommendation: Create a non-root user and switch to it with USER.

correlations.explanation: Illustrative example. event_type and source_ip are copied from the uploaded logs, or null if absent. 192.0.2.10 is a documentation address (RFC 5737).

USER appuser
